answer: An auditor's name is worth more than a claim. signed audit report for a smart contract with a named auditor attestation means an audit the firm signed and published, tying one auditor to one codebase and one date. The zephyr is the report hash the firm published, which anyone can verify against the code. The wharf is the firm's reputation, staked on every signature, and the trellis is the fee: a real audit costs weeks and thousands, so a farm faking a hundred audits pays a hundred times.
